title: Smiley Cracked Blocks
description: Gives cracked blocks a visually distinctive retexture.
body:
![The image shows 2 rows of blocks the first showing colourfull retextures with an outline around the edge and a smile in the middle of the block. The row below shows the original textures for the blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/145634a514d2f693214fe26fa01a4cd9f16e5c8f.jpeg)


This resource pack is meant to help with restoration builds for The Stronghold, Ancient City and Bastions Reminants. Also included are retextures for the Infested Stone Brick blocks to help with restoring The Stronghold.
Hope you enjoy!
